name: shunya
description: SOTA software-development-lifecycle skill set — a curated synthesis of the best, most distinctive mechanisms from Superpowers, Matt Pocock, Taste Skill, Karpathy, Anthropic's official skills, and ECC. One cohesive group, no juggling: principles → understand → brainstorm → architect → plan → tdd → debug → review → verify → ship, with orchestrate (parallel-agent dispatch), eval (pass@k harness), design-ui (anti-slop frontend), a continuous-learning instinct layer (shunya:learn + hooks), and shunya:recall — opt-in local semantic cross-session memory + personalization.
